mapper.sql: p.id AS post_id, p.title AS title, p.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, s.id AS spot_id, s.name AS spot_name, (SELECT i.object_key FROM community_image i WHERE i.post_id = p.id ORDER BY i.display_order LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail_key, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_image i2 WHERE i2.post_id = p.id) AS image_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_post_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS comment_count, p.view_count AS view_count, p.created_at AS created_at, p.updated_at AS updated_at
FROM community_post p JOIN member m ON m.id = p.member_id LEFT JOIN spot s ON s.id = p.spot_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select:
SELECT , LEFT(p.content, 100) AS text, NULL AS liked_by_me
ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , p.content AS text,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community_post_like lk WHERE lk.post_id = p.id AND lk.member_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me
NULL AS liked_by_me
WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
